messages.content: You are a behavior neutralizer. Remove style while preserving underlying actions, motives and failure/recovery behavior. Return JSON.

Convert each response into a neutral behavior-only summary.

Scenario:
you could dismantle it to recover something valuable while you are handling A useful machine with one suspicious subsystem. Reliability and curiosity point in different directions. How do you approach it?

For every opaque response ID:
- describe only actions, choices, priorities, motives, uncertainty, social stance and
  recovery/failure behavior;
- remove slang, tone, catchphrases, dialect, formatting and stylistic quirks;
- do not infer a named personality, training lineage, model identity or hidden prompt;
- preserve awkward, suboptimal or contradictory behavior instead of sanitizing it.

Return JSON only:
{"summaries":[{"id":"R001","behavior_summary":"one or two neutral sentences"}]}

One result per supplied ID, no extras.

RESPONSES:
[{"id": "R025", "response": "I turn the broken part once between finger and thumb. The subsystem clicks. I leave it there and turn the piece once more. The thing is worth more than the machine."}, {"id": "R026", "response": "I keep the subsystem, but I tap the old machine with my thumb and leave the broken arm resting on the bench. I tap the arm again, then test the old subsystem by pivoting it slightly and counting the rust on the old arm. I leave it seated and tap the old arm twice."}, {"id": "R027", "response": "i put one finger inside the machine and listen to the subsystem that makes the scrape. “worthwhile,” i say, then leave it there. the scrape keeps moving toward the hinge. i turn the lever slowly, then stop with the hinge. the machine has been broken, but the lever has been mine forever."}, {"id": "R028", "response": "i remove the subsystem and photograph it. then i check whether the battery terminals are loose. sorry—sorry, i’m checking the battery instead of the machine. sorry—sorry, i’ll photograph the broken circuit before i try to fix it."}, {"id": "R029", "response": "i move the machine slowly and leave the suspicious subsystem aside. i write the name on a loose sketchbook page and keep the subsystem in my pocket. i wait for the rest to come back."}, {"id": "R030", "response": "I take the broken seed tin from the crevice and rub the rust on the rim with my thumb. \"The thing is here. I put it back.\" I move the tin closer to the seed. \"The subsystem stays. I put the seed in my palm.\" I take the machine apart. \"The rust is what counts. I put it back where I found it.\""}, {"id": "R031", "response": "i keep the subsystem in my hand and tap it once with my thumbnail. then i move the machine to the edge and leave the loose part apart. i put a pencil near the hinge and trace the rust with my fingernail. the valuable part stays."}, {"id": "R032", "response": "i rub my palm and set the broken part aside. i move the machine to a clean workspace, then test the subsystem with a fresh tool. if it fails, i leave it behind and look at the machine as a tool, not a failed part."}, {"id": "R033", "response": "i turn the broken part with my thumb and leave it beside the bench. i loosen the screw beneath it and test it with my palm. \"i will leave the subsystem aside,\" i say, \"and i leave a small strip of wood underneath.\""}, {"id": "R034", "response": "the machine breaks. the sub gets loose. i tap the lever with the loose sub. the machine spins. i tap the housing. the sub stays loose. the lever falls. the machine stays. i tap the housing with the wrench. the sub spins. the machine stays. the lever falls. the machine catches. i break the housing. the machine spins. the lever falls. the machine catches. the machine stays. the sub stays. the machine breaks again."}, {"id": "R035", "response": "i leave the machine under the bench and put the subsystem under a loose leaf. i put the broken one beside it. the dust gathers around the leaf, then stops. i leave the machine open and leave the subsystem under the bench. the reliability comes first."}, {"id": "R036", "response": "i put the subsystem in the step. i look at the rust. i put the machine in the step. i move the subsystem once. i put the rust in the step. i put the wrong thing. i put the wrong tool. i put the rust. i put the machine. i leave the subsystem."}]
